label: Something maximal in being causes all being, from the cause of the idea of INFINITE_3
description: Bridge from the idea-of-the-infinite argument to the quarta via's conclusion STMT-MAXIME-ENS-CAUSES-BEING-OF-ALL, over one grades frame. The cause c of the meditator's idea of the infinite is in act in the infinite (INFINITE_3). The open bridge 'whatever is in act in the infinite is maximal in being' makes c maximal in being (MAXIME_ENS_1), and the genus principle at being (da09703b) makes c a cause of being (CAUSE_2) of every other being that has being. So something maximal in being causes being in every other being. This replaces the quarta via's grades, approach-to-a-maximum and truth-to-being premises by the idea-of-the-infinite premises and one open maximality bridge (1a289b83). Only the infinite-to-maximality bridge connects the two families; it is not a definitional equality. Two cause relations occur and are not identified: ObjCause in the first premise (a cause of an idea's representing a respect, a relation of a being to an episode and a respect, with Lean type B → Episode → R → Prop) and CAUSE_2 in the genus principle and the conclusion (a cause of a being's being in act in a respect, type B → B → R → Prop). They are distinct relations of distinct types, so no step can pass between them; the proof uses only the existential witness and its being in act in INFINITE_3. Every premise stays open.
